Ravensburger Cozy Retreat 500 Piece Large Format Jigsaw Puzzle for Adults - 14967 - Every Piece is Unique, Softclick Technology Means Pieces Fit Together Perfectly I have not done puzzles for years, but recently thought I might like to start again. My first puzzle was 1000 piece and to be honest with you, it was a little frustrating. My eyes aren’t what they used to be and the size of the puzzle was hard for me to work because of the table it was on. I had to stand up a lot to get to the top of the puzzle to work so it just wasn’t relaxing, this time I decided on the 500 piece and I bought this one without realizing the pieces were larger. I am working this on a puzzle mat and it is actually working out the size of 1000 piece puzzle because of the larger pieces. Just be aware of that if you have a smaller place to work your puzzles. So far I am finding this puzzle to be very relaxing and enjoyable there are enough objects in the puzzle so you can get a pretty good idea of where the pieces are going to go in the general area of the puzzle. The pieces are going together very nicely, and there was absolutely no puzzle dust whatsoever in the box.
I would definitely recommend this puzzle especially if you are just getting into puzzles or don’t want one that is very hard. This wouldn’t be considered extremely easy I don’t think but if you are looking for a challenge, I think this one might be a little too casual but for me just getting back into puzzles after years it’s been a very good choice. I’ve been working on it for a few hours today and I have a nice amount completed.
text_fidelity_b: Ravensburger Cozy Retreat 500 Piece Large Format Jigsaw Puzzle for Adults - 14967 - Every Piece is Unique, Softclick Technology Means Pieces Fit Together Perfectly

Kids First Big & Fun Microscope Science Experiment Kit | Easy-to-Use Kids Microscope | Ages 4-6 | STEM Experiment Guide and Full-Color User Manual | 72 Images | Extra-wide Eyepiec with Light-up Stage I was disappointed in this microscope, BUT it is for preschoolers. Each part was designed with them in mind. It doesn't magnify much, but it's for the benefit of their eyes. It's also designed so that they don't have to shut one eye to see. It's simple! If you're looking for something more advanced, you'll most definitely want to go another route. This one is more of a toy than a microscope.

It comes with 24 slides, with 3 items on each one. (Plus one blank one.) There's an included book that tells what it is on each of the slides(page 27 and 28). There's no storage for these at all. It would have been nice for a container or bag of some sort to be included to hold all of these. For now, we have the microscope and the slides within a basket, and that makes it easy to pull it off the shelf.

To use the light part of the microscope, you have to put in 2 AAA batteries, which are not included. Flip the switch and a light will come on. Just place a slide under the lens. (It will only go one way.) There's a knob that turns on the front, and this will move the slide back and forth. That's it. There's no way to zoom in and out.

I wouldn't recommend this microscope unless you want it as the most basic introduction to very young children(5ish and under). Even then if they've already been introduced to a microscope, they'll probably be disappointed in this one.
text_fidelity_b: Kids First Big & Fun Microscope Science Experiment Kit | Easy-to-Use Kids Microscope | Ages 4-6 | STEM Experiment Guide and Full-Color User Manual | 72 Images | Extra-wide Eyepiec with Light-up Stage

text_fidelity_a:
ALEX Toys Scientific Explorer Bee-Ology Science Kids Science Experiment Kit This is an interesting kit, that in all fairness should probably be about a 3.5 star product, but Amazon forces me to choose, so I'll rank this on the lower end.

There is a lot to like here - the activities are pretty good, the variety is great, and the educational value is fantastic. My daughter's favorite were the bee goggles, which was the simplest activity, while I liked the idea of building the model to identify the parts of the bee. There are some simple chits that you can move around to organize a hive that look like they belong in a board game, but didn't provide a lot of interest for daughter.

There are plenty of opportunities as well. The book that comes with the set is a big miss. There is a ton of information inside that helped me answer some questions for my daughter, but it is dry as a bone, and holds no interest for her whatsoever. It's essentially an encyclopedia entry about bees, and educationally, it's fabulous, but from a kid's point of view, they forgot to include anything fun.

There is one activity that requires you have a live flower, so that will be a miss for anyone doing this kit over a fall or winter season unless they want to take a separate trip to the store.

As I said above, there were 5 activities, and while I liked one or two, there's not too much to some of them. Pollinate a flower? OK, that's done in a few minutes. Bee wings buzzing? A fun toy, not too much really make use of here. The goggles were a hit with the kid, but are a dress up accessory at best for me. The model was great. The peel and stick bit was a good idea that didn't resonate with my little one.

Overall, it's a good idea, especially given the season we've tried it in, and in combination with our outdoor bee sanctuaries and veggie garden. Giving kids an education about these pollinators is important and could be a fantastic idea for the future, but for this kit, I think there's room for improvement.
text_fidelity_b: ALEX Toys Scientific Explorer Bee-Ology Science Kids Science Experiment Kit

text_fidelity_a:
Traxxas 6608 LaTrax Alias Quad-Rotor Ready-to-Fly Helicopter, Assorted Colors The Alias is potentially a great example of the new generation of quadcopters with electronic flight control boards that provide six axis stabilization. When their transmitter control levers are properly trimmed at the beginning of each flight they will hover very stably and are easy to fly even for a beginner.

Unfortunately, LaTrax and Traxxas (LaTrax makes the product and Traxxas provides all customer support) released the Alias before they found a good quality motor that works properly with the Alias. Since the Alias uses four motors and is inoperable if any one of the motors fails this is a major problem.

My Alias flew great for the first two days, but then it became very unstable and flew unpredictably. After only the the sixth or eighth flight one of the motors failed and the Alias would not fly at all.

Traxxas told me the Alias does fly unpredictably when one of its motors is weakening and getting ready to fail. They said they would send me a free replacement motor, but so far it has not arrived. Looking at other Amazon reviews, and on the internet, I see that many other people have also had very early motor failures. I strongly recommend people should not buy the Alias until LaTrax and Traxxas have figured out the early motor failure problem, presumably by finding a better motor.

Update: January 14, 2014

After two initial days of use before one of the motors broke, I have been unable to fly my new Alias for two and a half weeks now. Traxxas keeps saying they will send me a new motor as soon as the most recent batch they received "gets through quality control". I fear I have wasted $150 to buy the Alias.

Update January 20, 2014

After three weeks Traxxas finally sent me a replacement motor ....drum roll.....however, they sent the wrong motor! Traxxas checked their records, agreed they had sent the wrong motor, and promised to send the correct motor. I am pleased they are trying to provide good customer service, but I am now in my fourth week without being able to fly my otherwise excellent Alias after one of its motors broke on the second day after I opened it at Christmas.
text_fidelity_b: Traxxas 6608 LaTrax Alias Quad-Rotor Ready-to-Fly Helicopter, Assorted Colors

For the $72.00 you're getting 12 Light Sabers "colors" compare that to $250.00 and higher for one color. Now for the cons the blade is held in place by three set screws and it still has a bit of a lose feeling not much but its there. The other thing is the control button it is a bit cumbersome and by that I mean the holding down or pushing or doing the fast twist while holding button down to change sound fonts. I know some other saber makers use similar features but not this hard to change. One of the sound fonts is not even from Star Wars. I did not know what it was and could not stand it, but you might like. The problem was it took me several tries to change it and it should not be that hard to change.

So even with those two minor faults, this is still a great Saber for the price. As someone who was 10 years old when Star Wars came out, even now holding this and turning it on makes me smile.

"May the Force be with You"
text_fidelity_b: Neo Pixel Light Saber, 20 Light Effects & 17 Sound Fonts Changeable, 41inch Smooth Swing Metal Hilt Light Saber Toys for Boys Girls, Gifts for Boysfriend, Dueling Light Sabers for Cosplay

In case you're curious, a couple of the books are accordion folded paper, so there are pictures in them, but most are just filled with sponge sheet, so there are no actual pages. Civilization A New Dawn Board Game | Tactical Strategy Game for Adults and Teens Based on the Hit Video Game Series | Ages 14+ | 2-4 Players | Average Playtime 1-2 Hours | Made by Fantasy Flight Games Civilization: A New Dawn is indeed a new dawn in board gaming for this tried and true franchise. The Sid Meier property has had multiple iterations of previous games, each briging more and more complexity to the table. A New Dawn dials that back a good deal, abstracting many concepts, and doing away with large numbers of pieces and systems in favor of a more streamlined, simple and abstracted system.

And in almost every case, this new system works extremely well. Science and technology is particularly interesting to play with, requiring you to make great sacrfices in power and ability to move up the track in search of new ability. Even the game's winning conditions are easier to understand - the game's goal cards have two halves, and simply by fulfilling one side of each of three cards, you'll earn a victory. These neat and tidy new systems removed huge numbers of pieces from the game, and made the whole thing fit into a nice smaller sized box with a modular board for exploration, a nice touch from previous editions, many of which took place on a fairly boring board that looked like a small island.

The one area where the streamlining process fails, and where that failure comes down quite hard, is in the military systems. There is still a combat mechanic in the game, but because the game took away so many of the unit pieces and simplified down the fighting system, there is very little strategy, and many game-altering battles will be a simple "who rolls higher" contest with no modifiers or rerolls. This takes an otherwise strategic and highly contested game and breaks it all down to luck, ruining a large part of the experience for many.

This fatal flaw in the game is a big reason for my dislike of the game, but the game overall is quite good. It's a shame that this one element is going to make the game so polarizing. It's fun to a certain extent, but it does quite frequently just come down to randomness at the end.
text_fidelity_b: Civilization A New Dawn Board Game | Tactical Strategy Game for Adults and Teens Based on the Hit Video Game Series | Ages 14+ | 2-4 Players | Average Playtime 1-2 Hours | Made by Fantasy Flight Games

Branch cards can grow outward and upwards, so long as each new card you play touches only one other card you've used thusfar, which is much more difficult than it sounds, and so long as each main branch down to the root can score you ten or less points.

text_fidelity_a:
UNIH Dinosaur Play Dough Sets for Toddlers, Play Dough Tool Kit for Kids,36 Pcs Play Dough Accessories Dinosaur Playset Toys for Kids 3-5 (24 Pack Dough) My preschooler and my kindergartener were so happy to get this dinosaur playdoh set-- I can still see their bright smiles and hear their joyful squeals in my mind. They are home a lot, so I am always looking for ways to entertain them. We are currently studying a unit on dinos together, which I noticed my little one especially enjoyed. This set is so great-- as a family we have never seen so many colors of playdoh-- and my kids were so excited for all these colors! I actually had to give them only some at a time so we didn't end up overwhelming them.

Unlike many toys the playtime with this set is actually pretty lengthy-- yayyyy! They are working on their creative, fine motor, sensory, communication and imagination skills all at once, and we have dialogue about some facts we learned about dinos while we play. The plastic molds are cute, fun, easy to use and easy to keep clean. The molds are sturdy enough they will not break easily. I usually let them figure things out on their own, but the video that was on the listing was enjoyable so I showed it to my kids and they wanted to watch repeatedly, then try on their own. There's still quite a bit of self-discovery to be had, and they took their time trying out all the different pieces. I'm thrilled this set was and still is such a hit with my boys! Regular brand name PlayDoh can of course be used with this set (we usually buy from Costco, but needed this set for the dino tools).
text_fidelity_b: UNIH Dinosaur Play Dough Sets for Toddlers, Play Dough Tool Kit for Kids,36 Pcs Play Dough Accessories Dinosaur Playset Toys for Kids 3-5 (24 Pack Dough)

text_fidelity_a:
The Resistance (The Dystopian Universe) The resistance is a fantastic game with a great price and superb components. The rules are very simple also so the game can be picked up by nearly anyone in a matter of minutes. A sample round will remove any doubt about the rules and is often the best way I have found to teach the game.

So what is this about? The Resistance is a game of guessing and deduction that is rules light and fun heavy. In the basic game 5 to 10 players take on the role of either good guys or bad guys by being dealt cards that depict their character. Good guys or the resistance are blue and spies are red. The ratio of spies to resistance is driven by the number of players in a game. The spies always have fewer allies in the game than do the resistance players.

Once the players have secretly looked at their role card, everyone closes their eyes. The first player commands everyone to close their eyes, he then commands the spies and only the spies to open their eyes and look around to identify each other, he then commands them to close their eyes and lastly commands everyone to open their eyes.

So now the spies know who each other are but the allies have no idea.

The game is then played as 5 simple 'missions'. A mission consists of the first player choosing a number
of players to 'go on the mission'. The number is dependent on how many total players are playing. The more players, the more involved in each mission. Each mission from 1 to 5 will have gradually more players involved.

Everyone votes to allow or disallow the chosen players to go on the mission. Each player will have two cards to vote
with each round. These cards are marked clearly with symbols to indicate if you do or do not agree to allow the chosen players to play.

Here is where the game gets going. If the vote fails to allow the chosen players to go on the mission twice in a row, the spies win automatically.

If the players allow the mission to go forward, those players involved get to either make the mission successful or to sabotage the mission. This is done my dealing each player involved in the mission two cards. One of each success and sabotage. They secretly place their cards into two piles. The mission result and the dead pile.

Spies can sabotage or succeed a mission and the resistance players MUST succeed the mission.

The majority of succeed of sabotage rules the mission.

Rounds continue like this until the spies or the resistance have a best 3 out of 5 missions won by their side.

Up until this point your first game might seem kinda boring. But just wait, almost immediately you will figure
out who your junior sleuths are! Finger pointing and accusations will begin to fly out of the most timid players
mouths!

You will find players who are just 100% certain they know who is who and are almost always wrong! You will find out that some of your friends are REALLY GREAT LIARS and some are REALLY POOR LIARS!

The compound the fun there is also a plot deck. The plot deck is simply a deck of cards that each round, one is dealt by the first player and he can give it to someone else or keep it.
These cards are things like 'look at someone else role card' or 'veto a vote'.

I initially thought the plot deck would be horrible but I was very wrong. The first time we pulled a card that let one player look at another players role card the player looked and claimed the other player was a spy. The player accused immediately did a double take and denied the allegation fervently!

We were back at square one but now had two more people we couldn't trust! FUN! FUN! FUN!

You cannot go wrong with this game unless you live in a convent full of people with ZERO personality who have had all their fun genes removed.

So if you are looking for an excellent game, with super components, short playing time, and an immeasurable amount of fun, look no further than this gem!
text_fidelity_b: The Resistance (The Dystopian Universe)

Hasbro Gaming Deluxe Turntable Scrabble Remarkable. Scrabble is cool. Hep. Rad. Outta sight. But Scrabble in this deluxe form is sublime, intoxicating. The pieces stay put, thanks to little walls around each space. You can spin the board so as to not need to examine it upside down. The pieces never slide around. The plastic coating lets you wipe it off, unlike the cardboard version which stains. Nothing is compromised from the original, flat cardboard version, but everything is improved.

OK. Not everything. It still can't help you dump the Q, Z and J at the end of the game without a U. And it is unlikely to assist you in stopping your grandmother's amazing ability to squeeze you out of that triple word score you hoped to grab with a seven-letter word. Take that up with Gram. Just remember who made you the cookies.

Seriously, I recommend this to any family or commited Scrabble player. Families need it for that `full-body contact' style of play that sometimes happens with children or cats involved. Commited Scrabble players need it for pretty much the same reason!

I fully recommend this game.

Anthony Trendl
editor, HungarianBookstore.com
text_fidelity_b: Hasbro Gaming Deluxe Turntable Scrabble

Big Bag of Glow in The Dark Science, for Kids 8-12 - Lab in A Bag of to Make Glowing Slime & 50+ Illuminating Experiments - STEM Science Chemistry Experiment Set - Gifting Idea for Boys & Girls Wow, we are half way thru the experiments and I can not say enough good stuff about this product. We are using it for preschool/kindergarten home-school intro to chemistry. Even the experiments I thought were less "interesting", like color tablets and mixing, turned out to be a real thrill to the little ones.

I was initially concerned about the quality of the equipment and the safety of the experiments. I tend to be harsh in my judgement of quality. Kiddo's are 3,5, & 6 so I have to say in all honesty that I am very thankful the contained "chemicals" are all nontoxic. Had a real hard time with keeping the "snow" out of little mouths. And the quality of equipment is amazing. THIS STUFF IS DURABLE! The kiddos tend to be innocently destructive. Everything is sturdy enough for the youngest 2, one of which is a typical boy, and everything is brightly colored so we can find it every time it lands on the floor. This is important since part of the "science" "learning" value is lost if they can't get into the bag and unpack/handle everything.

All experiments are carefully explained, thought provoking, forward thinking questions are provided. If you should run into any problems, YouTube seems to have a video on all the experiments. I would highly recommend this kit for anyone with younger kids interested in science.

Thames & Kosmos Ooze Labs Colorful Crystal Lab STEM Experiment Kit & Lab Setup | Awesome Geometric Crystals, Dazzling Displays, with 11 Shiny, Sparkly, Safe Experiments | Stickers to Decorate Your Lab These days with many kids doing home schooling due to lockdowns, this would be a great home schoolilng science project or lesson.

The age recommendation is for children six and up, however since most of these experiments require the use of a pot of boiling water, I think the manufacturer should increase the age requirement. Parental supervision is of course a great idea. The booklet is easy to understand, however it might be more difficult for younger children to read and understand the instructions.

I only tried the first experiment in the kit and it worked as expected, and it was the easiest, fastest experiment to get results. The instructions were easy to follow. (I also lacked any distilled water which many of the experiment recipes call for). It was fun for me as an adult to try.

I am not sure if this is an option or not, but it would be nice if refills on the "magic water, colors, (maybe even some not available in this kit) and paper cones) were made available so kids (or adults) can continue to keep playing and making different crystals. (Alum powder and food coloring are both readily available at any grocer.)

The box is attractively marked and would make a great gift for any adult or child who likes science or educational toys. This kit is compatible with other chemistry sets available from the same company.

All in all, it's a fun, educational kit that anyone can enjoy. The only true down side is that it may try the patience of kids who like instant results. Some of these experiments take two or three days to have decent crystals develop. I liked the kit and found it fascinating. I can't wait to try the other experiments in the kit.
text_fidelity_b: Thames & Kosmos Ooze Labs Colorful Crystal Lab STEM Experiment Kit & Lab Setup | Awesome Geometric Crystals, Dazzling Displays, with 11 Shiny, Sparkly, Safe Experiments | Stickers to Decorate Your Lab

text_fidelity_a: Perplexus Rookie (Styles and Colors Vary) My 8 year old daughter received the Perplexus for Christmas, and our whole family fought over it for the rest of the holiday break.  My youngest turned four in early January, so I immediately ordered the Rookie version for him.  It arrived quickly, as we've become accustomed to when shopping Amazon, so ordering on December 27th for a January 2nd party was not a problem. It's been in my son's grubby little paws for five days  now and he is enamored of the thing.  It's wonderful to see my very large, very rough and tumble four year old boy carefully, slowly, cautiously navigate this little ball bearing around the maze.  He twist it, turns it, lifts it so he can see it from the bottom, and growls when the ball falls off the track.  But then he gets right back to it.  He has beaten it, but that doesn't seem to diminish his interest in trying again.  Whoever came up with this idea for this toy has my respect.  I only gave it four stars for durability because it seems like it could be a little higher quality.  For such an amazing toy, the materials should be of a high enough quality to make it an heirloom.  It is honestly one of my favorite toys, along with quadrilla and magnatiles, so I wish it was a little more substantial.  We have had no problems with it as of yet, though, after five days of heavy use.
text_fidelity_b: Perplexus Rookie (Styles and Colors Vary)

text_fidelity_a:
The Resistance I picked up The Resistance to play at family gatherings where mafia and werewolf didn't go over so well. People didn't like getting eliminated and didn't like someone needing to moderate/narrate the game. The resistance is best played with more people. The more the merrier definitely is true here. Some people will play as the resistance and some as spies. The spies are trying to sabotage the missions while the resistance is trying to complete the missions. The game has a mission leader who will pick which players are going to go on the mission. The game then opens discussion to all players to decide if that is the best choice of players for the mission.

Overall, We enjoyed the game, but when playing with only 5 players, it's a bit too easy and people don't really get into the discussion. When playing with 8-10 players, the game is a lot more fun as people really get into the accusations and deciding who should go on the different missions. Since people aren't eliminated like mafia and werewolf, people tend to enjoy this game more.
text_fidelity_b: The Resistance

text_fidelity_a:
Blade Inductrix FPV RTF (Yellow) I am a complete newbie to drones. I've operated one of the Phantom 3 drones that my son owns, which is a completely different animal. So, out of the box, I was completely dependent on the instructions to get me up and running. After looking through the last of five instruction sheets, I finally found the English version. Without going into great detail, I'll just say that it was not easy at all finding and understanding the basic minimum to get you in the air. There is a lot of terminology about components that I had no idea what was being referred to. Example: Three-in-one control unit. It took me considerable time to figure out that the three-in-one control unit is a part of the quad copter itself. Now, it must be acknowledged that this is an unbelievable amount of technology in such a small package. So I guess it's a little much to expect that it would be simple to operate. But after getting the battery charged and after a few trials and errors, I got the copter in the air. The included video screen actually has a reasonably clear picture. And after a lot of practice I got to where I could fly it through my house, upstairs from controlling downstairs and still got good video reception and control. This little unit is built pretty tough. And it needs to be, because, especially if you're a newbie, you'll crash a lot. It really took a beating on my hardwood floors. Carpeted floors would be a lot easier on the equipment. While the drone is very durable and has built in protection for the video camera, I broke several of the stanchions that attach the motors to the circular blade guard. I was able to use instant glue and get back in the air. But the good news is that individual parts are sold separately so it can evidently be fairly easily repaired.

This little drone is very fun to fly. Battery life on the one single included battery is consistently about 3 minutes per flight. It takes about 15 minutes to charge. As has been recommended in several articles I've read, I will be purchasing additional batteries and a gang-charger. I'll give this unit four stars. The value for the price is, I believe, very good. The main frustrating drawback is the lack of more simple and basic instructions. It's far from an "open-the-box-and-fly" unit. But if you have the patience to stick with it and improve your skills, it's tremendously fun to fly!
text_fidelity_b: Blade Inductrix FPV RTF (Yellow)

First I will tell you, I'm a huge Star Wars Fan. Also a big kid when it comes to Light Sabers and Star Wars LEGO Ultimate Collector Series. That being said, I own several Light sabers from other companies. The The Black Series and such.

Now what I love about this Light Saber from Artcube Direct. The Price, Sound Fonts, Colors, Effects and rechargeable battery. They are all great and better than most Black Series because with most of them you get one color for $250.00. Now of course the hilt is so much better looking, but this just shows you how much they over priced they are.

Now for the Frustrating Part. The one Button to do everything. To make it plain and simple it sucks. I have yet been able to adjust the volume, it's stuck on high. When I try to adjust I end up changing the color or sound font. The owners manual say's hold button for 0.5 seconds, then you can pick high, low, or mute. The other features are the same way hold for so long then LED light around button flashes so many times to pick.

I thought it was just me so I let my brother try and his kids and none could get it to work the way we wanted. You're always changing a setting you don't want to by accident.

Even with the Frustrating button control it still looks awesome and is very bright blade. This could easily be a Five Star rating, but with the button issues I'm only giving Three Stars.

text_fidelity_a:
Lost Cities - The Board Game Lost Cities TBG is a lot like the original Lost Cities Card Game, but it supports more than 2-players. That's a nice feature.

For those who don't know, Lost Cities the Card Game is considered legendary among hobby board gamers because it's simple, but deep, meaning that anyone can pick up the rules to the game quite quickly, but there's interesting decision-making and complex outcomes to worry about based on your decisions. Of course, it's only a 2-player game, which can be a downfall for many.

The Board Game version is similar in terms of gameplay. If you've already experienced the card game, I could teach you this version in about 30 seconds. Unfortunately, you'll soon want to be back playing the card game. This game lacks a certain something to make it really fun. It works, and it's still easy to learn and play, but I don't think I'll come back to it all that often unless I'm playing with my daughter. For those who are into more complex games, this one just feels...old fashioned. In all the ways that the card game has aged well, this one hasn't.
text_fidelity_b: Lost Cities - The Board Game

Crayola Dino Destruction Stomping Mall I'll mention the texture first. It's *somewhat* like a mix between sand and play-doh. Therefore, it's super grainy feeling. Aside from that, it's really fun! My kids(2 and 5) love playing with it. There are quite a few molds included to make things such as cars and houses for the dinosaur to "stomp". As a momma of 3 little ones, it's one of those toys that will buy me some time to do one of the many things I have to do. I can put this on the table to occupy my oldest two and it will get me enough time to cook supper(or whatever).

Overall, we recommend this! My little ones have had a blast with it!

“Winning comes naturally, I mean, just look at me.”

“This storm is only getting stronger.”

text_fidelity_a:
Solar System Model Sun and Earth Building Sets Educational Mechanically Rotating Creative Building Blocks Set Classroom Kid's Brain-Inspired Toys,New 2021（471pcs） This is a great LEGO-style set. Good instructions. Good packaging. Very exciting build for my 11 year old son. Only one or two tough sections that I had to help him with as the build seems to ask for a few unofficial techniques and the parts did not quit fit without a LOT of elbow grease.

The only downside was a missing gear. It would have been a serious issue, but we have a lot of official LEGO parts lying around from MOCs that we build. We found the part and completed the build.

Very nice motion. Be sure to properly tighten down all the parts.

Recommended!
